newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq hit new record on strength of tech stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq hit new record on strength of tech stocks.

text.p: Continued strength in technology stocks and strong corporate earnings lifted Nasdaq shares to a new record Friday.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 8.94 points or 0.63 percent to close unofficially at 1349.40, topping a record set January 14 of 1346.36.
The Dow industrials gained 68 points to close unofficially at 6833, its first close over 6800. The long-bond gained 1/32 to yield 6.83 percent in late trading.
"It was a busy day. Very strong on tech strength. And I don't see anything that tells me it's going to stop anytime soon," said Nicholas Karos, senior over-the-counter trader at Piper Jaffray.
Traders said technology stocks were very active ahead of Microsoft Corp's earnings report. After the market closed, Microsoft posted better-than-expected second quarter earnings of $0.57 a share.

Active stocks included Cascade Communications Corp, which surged 8-1/8 to 60 and Ascend Communications Inc, which jumped 6-1/8 to 75. Uniphase Corp, however, was less lucky and dropped 5-1/4 to 40-3/4 after posting disappointing second quarter revenues.
